item.title: Good Morning Australia - 21 May 2026
item.description:
Hello breakfast crew!
Welcome to Good Morning Australia!
Today is Thursday, the 21 May.
Wake up sleepyheads, it’s time to start the day.
In Bendigo today, it will be mostly sunny, with a low of 6 degrees and a top of 15 degrees.
There is about a 0 percent chance of rain.
You might need a warm jumper today.
Today’s letter is K.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter K?
Today’s number is 1.
Can you clap 1 times?
Today’s Australian animal is the emu.
Did you know?
Emus
